prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: transparent eight-pose staff-character source sheet for review
Primary request: Create one cohesive rounded full-body pixel-art sheet for the or nurse employee in Image2. Image1 controls the established same-role uniform cues, pixel-art style, proportional scale and eight-pose layout. Image2 controls the NEW identity and every uniform detail: a 45-year-old adult man with medium olive skin, short straight black hair swept flat to one side with a narrow silver temple streak, a small dark chin goatee without a moustache and no glasses, and a sturdy build. They wear matching muted-steel-blue short-sleeved V-neck operating-room nursing scrubs with one square chest pocket, cargo trouser pockets and a short cream waist drawstring, and black clinical sneakers; no cap. Preserve every detail across all eight views.
Composition/framing: exactly two rows of four isolated full-body figures. Top left-to-right: standing SOUTH/front, EAST/true profile facing screen-right, WEST/true profile facing screen-left, NORTH/rear. Bottom same order: seated SOUTH/EAST/WEST/NORTH. Broad transparent gutters, generous row gap and outer margins; every head and shoe fully visible well away from canvas edges. Seated figures sit on invisible chairs, knees bent around 90 degrees, hands naturally on thighs, feet flat; no chair visible. Same head/body scale and proportions in standing and seated views. Scrub/uniform sleeves remain short, ending above the elbows in ALL eight views; no accidental long sleeves. No hat, surgical cap or headwear. Pockets, collar, badge placement and garment hems stay consistent; coats/jackets rest naturally while seated.
Style/medium: Compact rounded proportions, large expressive head, clean dark pixel-stepped outline, restrained two/three-tone cel shading and crisp softly shaded pixel-art finish exactly matching the existing role art in Image1 and the accepted v6a/v6b cohort. Do not make a taller, realistic, glossy, vector-flat or photorealistic figure.
Constraints: genuine transparent RGBA background; no chair, furniture, floor, cast shadow, glow, held equipment, scenery, text, readable badge, logos, watermarks, labels, grid, missing/duplicate/cropped poses. A described badge stays blank. No stethoscope, needle, test tube, medication or tool.
